# ISO 9001 Malaysia (isoconsultantmalaysia.com)

> ISO 9001:2015 quality management system (QMS) consultancy in Malaysia, provided by AA Alive Sdn Bhd (SSM 1204108-D) since 2016. We prepare organisations for certification by an accredited certification body; we do not issue certificates ourselves.

Last updated: 2026-09-24

## Company
- Legal name: AA Alive Sdn Bhd
- SSM registration: 1204108-D
- Consulting since: 2016
- Founder and Managing Director: Evin Lim
- Address: Lot 1, Jalan Perusahaan 4, Pusat Industri Amari, Kawasan Industri Batu Caves, 68100 Batu Caves, Selangor, Malaysia

## Services
- ISO 9001 quality management system (QMS) consulting
- Gap analysis against ISO 9001:2015
- QMS documentation: quality manual, procedures, forms and records
- Staff training: quality awareness and internal auditor training
- Internal audit and management review support
- Preparation and support for the certification body (CB) Stage 1 and Stage 2 audits
- ISO 14001 (environmental) and ISO 45001 (occupational health and safety) consulting are also offered, including integrated management systems

## Pricing
- SME Package (5–30 employees): from RM 13,000
- Professional Package (30–100 employees): RM 22,000
- Enterprise Package (100+ employees or multi-site): custom quotation
- Certification body audit fees are not included. They are quoted separately by the certification body and typically range from RM 3,000 to RM 8,000, depending on organization size.

## First consultation
The first consultation is free and without obligation (WhatsApp, phone or video). Paid work starts only after the client accepts a written proposal.
